newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FORMER ENGLAND CAPTAIN ROBSON PLANNING TO HANG UP HIS BOOTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FORMER ENGLAND CAPTAIN ROBSON PLANNING TO HANG UP HIS BOOTS.

text.p: Former England captain Bryan Robson is planning to hang up his boots.
Robson, player-manager of Middlesbrough, made a premier league comeback against Arsenal on New Year's Day, 10 days short of his 40th birthday.
But he has not pencilled his name on the teamsheet for Saturday's F.A. Cup third round tie against Chester because of another sciatica attack.

Robson, capped 90 times by England, said on Friday: "I really enjoyed the Arsenal game, apart from the result, but my sciatica played me up and I just about finished the game. Hopefully, I will not be needed again."
Robson has made 726 cup and league appearances for West Bromwich, Manchester United and Middlesbrough.
